purpose: Teach: その道/エゴ/やう/正午/未明/ナンセンス/アンタ/初歩

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゲームでその道のプロだな
lines.en: Riku, you're seriously a pro when it comes to games.
lines.style: Light, admiring observation. Quick tempo, direct eye contact. Playful respect — not gushing, just stating a fact she knows he knows.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、エゴを抑えてチームプレーしてたな、桜
lines.en: You actually held back your ego and played as a team, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet admission underneath the words. Slight surprise in the opening — like he didn't expect to notice this in her. Warm. Not quite meeting her eyes but sincere.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ふざけて「やう」って書き込んでたな
lines.en: Riku, you were joking around writing 'yau' in the chat.
lines.style: Dry, knowing smirk in the delivery. Teasing lilt on the observation. She's catching him in something small and calling it out with affection.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、正午に必ずおにぎり食ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were always eating an onigiri right at noon, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost wondering. Soft pace. The way someone notices a detail about another person because they've been paying attention longer than they meant to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、未明までゲームしてたな
lines.en: Riku, you'd stay up gaming until almost dawn.
lines.style: Wry, knowing tone. Slight shake of the head in the voice. Not judging — documenting what he does when he thinks nobody's watching.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト勉強しないでナンセンスな話ばっかしてたな、桜
lines.en: You never studied for tests — you just talked nonsense the whole time, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry half-laugh underneath. Affectionate exasperation. The complaint of someone who watched this happen repeatedly and somehow found it endearing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、後輩を「アンタ」呼ばわりするなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't call your underclassmen 'anta' like that.
lines.style: Sharp but not unkind. A real correction — she means it. Tone shifts to something steadier, more serious. Still his friend, but drawing a line.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、漢字を初歩から覚え直してたな、桜
lines.en: You were relearning kanji from the beginning, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft, admiring recognition. Slower pace on the middle words. Not calling it out as a flaw — seeing the effort, the willingness to go back and do the work right.
